note: Verified callout stats with sources; used for scroll-step copy and stat cards

concern_peak.text: of Britons named immigration a top issue in Sept 2025 — highest since 2015

net_migration_fall.text: fall in UK net migration from peak (944k YE Mar 2023 to 171k YE Dec 2025)

think_rising.text: of Britons thought immigration had risen in the past year — it had more than halved

boats_share.text: of gross UK immigration arrived by small boat in 2025 (41,472 of 813,000)

visa_share.text: of UK arrivals YE Mar 2025 came on work or study visas

uk_per_capita.text: UK rank in Europe for asylum applications per capita (5th in absolute terms)

eu_irregular_share.text: of migration to the EU is irregular (239k detections vs 3.5M residence permits, 2024)

frontex_fall.text: fall in EU irregular crossings 2023-2025 (380k to 178k); H1 2026 down another 37%

syria_fall.text: fall in Syrian asylum applications in 2025 after the fall of Assad

hosted_poor.text: of the world's refugees are hosted by low- and middle-income countries

hosted_neighbour.text: of refugees live in a country neighbouring their own

ukraine_tp.text: people under EU temporary protection (Apr 2026) — a legal flow 25x the size of 2025's irregular crossings

med_deaths.text: dead or missing in the Mediterranean since 2014

deadliest_year.text: migrant deaths worldwide in 2024 — the deadliest year on record

resettlement_fall.text: fall in global refugee resettlement in 2025 (188.8k to 81.8k); UNHCR-supported departures fell to ~37k

us_ceiling.text: US refugee admissions ceiling for FY2026 — lowest ever (was 125,000)

crime_belief.text: of Britons believe immigrants increase crime (up from 30% in 2023); studies find no causal link

nrpf.text: most UK visas carry 'No Recourse to Public Funds' — no Universal Credit, housing benefit or child benefit

obr_fiscal.text: OBR: an average-wage migrant arriving at 25 contributes more over a lifetime than a UK-born worker on the same wage

ceuta_day.text: crossed into Ceuta in a single day (Aug 2026); 80+ died; all were returned within 24h; none reached mainland EU

austria_paradox.text: has Europe's harshest benefit regime for asylum seekers - and had its highest per-capita application rates. Deterrence-by-benefits doesn't work
